notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.3.1 - Bug fix on level 16 of North America
notes.content:
[b]Hi![/b]

[b]Version 1.0.3.1[/b] fixes a bug on level 16 of the North America, where the truck is incorrectly positioned underground at the start of the level, causing a hit.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.3 - Fixes and additions
notes.content:
[b]Hi![/b]

[b]Version 1.0.3[/b] brings two main updates to the game. First, a fix to the hitting system. We received feedback that hits were being registered even if the vehicle wasn’t moving from the same object. This is now fixed, so if the player hits something, additional hits will not register unless the player continues driving into the object.

The second addition in this hotfix is a requested feature: the ability to move the third-person camera to the rear of the vehicle. Now, by pressing "X" or the left D-pad on the gamepad, the third-person camera will toggle between the front and rear of the vehicle when driving vehicles with trailers. To accommodate this feature, the vehicle reset in Blind Spot has been moved to the bottom face button on gamepads.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.2 - Quick fixes
notes.content:
Hi!

Hotfix 1.0.2 fixes some urgent bugs and possible crash culprits.

The game now includes an FOV slider in the settings, as this was a requested feature and was relatively easy to implement within a shorter time frame.

Other updates are also in progress, but they will take a bit more time. Auto-braking has also been made a bit stronger, as it previously felt a bit weak. The option to disable auto-braking in the settings and use only manual braking is also in the works for a future update.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.1 - Small human error fixes
notes.content:
Version: 1.0.1

Found a couple human errors and fixed them:
-Mirror being flipped in Sandbox
-Bad hitbox

notes.title: Update 1.0 - Ready for Release
notes.content:
[b]Hello fellow drivers![/b]

The wait is finally over—[b]Version 1.0[/b] is here, and we’re incredibly excited that [b]Reverse Problem[/b] will officially be purchasable tomorrow, [b]February 19th! [@2:00 PM GMT+2][/b]

After months of hard work, testing, and fine-tuning, we’ve reached this milestone and can’t wait for you to dive in!

notes.title: Hotfix 0.5.4 - Quality of Life Improvements
notes.content:
Version 0.5.4:

-Possible rare crash issue fixes
-Fixes to misspellings in translations
-Some level layout improvements
-Hitbox improvements
-Fixes for changing between keyboard and gamepad on the fly

notes.title: Hotfix 0.5.3 - Small additions
notes.content:
Version 0.5.3 Update:

The Slipstream minigame mode is now more challenging and engaging.

Other additions:
-Ships now move in the distance on select levels, making the game world feel more alive.
-Minor adjustments to unnecessary difficult levels.
-Various bug fixes.

notes.title: Hotfix 0.5.2 - Quality of Life Improvements
notes.content:
Hi fellow drivers!

Version 0.5.2 fixes some minor bugs and brings some performance improvements.

notes.title: Hotfix 0.5.1 - Feature updates
notes.content:
Hi fellow drivers!

Version 0.5.1
-Fixed mirrors being the wrong way
-Added a modeled steering wheel to the vehicle's interior
-Added the ability to run while outside the vehicle
-Minor performance improvements

notes.title: Update 0.5 - Rework for sandbox mode controls and UI and Frame rate limiter
notes.content:
Hi fellow drivers!

Update 0.5 completely reworks the building system in Sandbox mode for keyboard and mouse. The game's settings now also feature a frame rate limiter, allowing players to choose their preferred FPS limit.

Update 0.5 also fixes some minor bugs and brings performance improvements.

notes.title: Hotfix 0.4.10 - Quality of Life Improvements
notes.content:
Hi fellow drivers!

Version 0.4.10 brings the ability to make the player's camera follow the vehicle. This can be toggled in the settings, allowing players to choose their preferred way of keeping the camera still or having it follow the vehicle.

0.4.10 also brings some fixes to some janky hitboxes in the level assets, making them more precise.

notes.title: Hotfix 0.4.9 - Quality of Life Improvements
notes.content:
Hi fellow drivers!

Version 0.4.9 fixed some minor bugs and changed the game's running program name from 'ReverseProblem' to 'Reverse Problem' (with a space in between).

notes.title: Hotfix 0.4.6 - Level Progression
notes.content:
Hi fellow drivers!

While doing beta test we got feedback on the games level progression, being a bit bothersome. Before you needed to complete all levels to proceed to the next level, but this could get annoing if the player gets stuck on a specific level. 

You will now unlock the next two levels from a completed level to have choice on progression.

notes.title: Development Update - January 2025
notes.content:
Hi fellow drivers!

We are excited to announce that the game now features proper interiors.

Originally, the game only had a first-person view from the front of the vehicle, but we asked for feedback on whether there should be proper interiors. The responses we received were mostly in favor of adding them.

You can find an extended showcase video of the interiors on our YouTube channel @TAGAXLEGAMES.
